On November 6, 2026, the Board of Directors (the “Board”) of Mueller Industries Inc. (the “Company”) appointed Devin K. Denner to the Board, effective January 1, 2027, to fill the vacancy to be created by the previously reported retirement of Gary S. Gladstein from the Board effective December 31, 2026. Mr. Denner brings decades of business leadership experience in the metals industry. The Board has determined that Mr. Denner is “independent” under the rules of The New York Stock Exchange and the rules and regulations under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended. There is no arrangement or understanding between Mr. Denner and any other person pursuant to which he was selected as a director, nor are there any transactions between the Company and Mr. Denner or any of his immediate family members (within the meaning of Item 404 of Regulation S-K) that require disclosure pursuant to Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K. Mr. Denner will participate in the Company’s non-employee director compensation program, which for the current compensation year consists of an annual fee of $82,000 and a new director initial equity grant with a grant date fair value of $170,000. Each of the annual fee and the new director initial equity grant will be prorated for the partial year to be served. Item 8.01 Other Events. On November 6, 2026, the Registrant issued a press release announcing that its Board has declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of 17.5 cents per share on its common stock. The dividend will be paid December 18, 2026 to shareholders of record on December 4, 2026. A copy of the press release announcing the payment and record dates is attached as Exhibit 99.1.
